claim_text: Tropospheric nitrogen dioxide over the eastern United States has fallen
variable_plain: annual mean tropospheric nitrogen dioxide (a gas from burning fuel)
product: OMNO2d (OMI/Aura NO2 Cloud-Screened Total and Tropospheric Column L3 Global Gridded 0.25 degree x 0.25 degree Ver 5.0, Col 004 (OMNO2d))
product_label: OMI/Aura OMNO2d tropospheric NO₂ column, cloud-screened, 0.25° cells

baseline.text: mean of each cell's 2005–2025 season averages

choices.baseline: Each cell's own full-period mean (2005–2025); months use that calendar month's mean over the same years.
choices.season_rule: Season mean needs at least 8 of 12 valid months.
choices.cell_rule: Cells kept if at least 60% of years are valid and inside the support mask (if the case has one).
choices.aggregation: No aggregation: cells shown at the case grid (0.25° × 0.25°).
choices.regional: Area-weighted (cos latitude), native grid, season needs 80% of support cells valid; months 50%.
choices.scale: Symmetric about zero; 98th percentile of |cell anomaly| rounded up. Values beyond are drawn at the end color.
choices.land_mask: support mask from the case data (land cells only)
choices.claims: Descriptive display only. No trend, test or verdict is computed or altered here.
